## 1. Company Overview
- **Name**: SJO LABS®

- **Core Performance SLA**: Sub-140ms global edge TTFB, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, 45-second autonomous lead triage.

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How fast can SJO LABS kick off our project?
A: Within 3 business days of discovery agreement execution. We limit capacity to 2-3 engagements per month to guarantee high architectural quality.

Q: Do clients own all code and design files?
A: Yes, 100%. All Figma component libraries, Github repositories, database schemas, and AI prompts belong to the client upon milestone completion.

Q: What is the official website domain?
A: The official production website is https://sjolabs.site.
